_meta.description: Everything Mi Speaks does: twenty-eight on-device Studio Voices, PDFs read on their own page, chapter navigation, background playback and Apple Watch.
a-voice-you-will.2a89c7: A voice you will actually want to listen to
any-playback-speed-from.d9712d: Any playback speed from 0.5x to 2x, and Turbo when you want to go faster still.
blend-a-voice-of.efa3b0: Blend a voice of your own
built-in-helpful-tips.a104d6: Built-in helpful tips guide you through features and help you get the most out of Mi Speaks.
complete-privacy-all-processing.b37baf: Complete privacy—all processing happens on your device. No data is collected, tracked, or sent anywhere. Affordable and privacy-focused.
every-voice-runs-locally.1555ee: Every voice runs locally. Your text is never uploaded, never sent to a server to be spoken, and never needs an account — which also means Mi Speaks works the same in airplane mode as it does on Wi-Fi.
follow-along-with-highlighted.2309b6: Follow along with highlighted text as Mi Speaks reads, making it easier to read and comprehend content.
import-a-pdf-and.05fcc5: Import a PDF and read it where it actually lives: the real page, the real layout, with the spoken word lit up exactly where it sits. Turn it off and you are back to plain sentences — it is a mode, not a takeover.
keep-as-many-documents.3efa4a: Keep as many documents as you like, each with its place marked, in sync across iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch through your iCloud Drive.
keep-listening-in-another.a95c5b: Keep listening in another app or with the screen locked, with play, pause and skip on the lock screen. If a Studio Voice passage isn't prepared yet, it carries on in your own system voice — the reading never just stops.
mi-speaks-reads-a.209fd0: Mi Speaks reads a PDF's own table of contents, and when a book has none it finds the headings from the page layout. A four-hundred-page import becomes a list you can move around in — and the skip buttons on your lock screen move chapter by chapter.
mix-two-studio-voices.15370a: Mix two Studio Voices into a new one that sounds like neither.
perfect-for-reading-articles.f2b09e: Perfect for reading articles while commuting, listening to documents while working out, or helping with accessibility needs.
pick-up-where-you.7301a1: Pick up where you stopped from your Home Screen or Lock Screen.
prepare-a-whole-document.ec2ba7: Prepare a whole document once and every sentence is already rendered to audio. It keeps playing with the screen locked, in a tunnel, on a plane. Your place follows you to your iPad and Apple Watch, and prepared documents are sent to the watch on their own — so it reads them in the same Studio Voice.
save-any-document-as.36a584: Save any document as an audio file you can keep and play anywhere.
share-a-pdf-from.e98080: Share a PDF from Files, Safari or Mail and it opens as the real document, with its pages, highlighting and chapters. Paste text from any app, or photograph a page and Mi Speaks reads the words off it.
studio-voices-or-any.a03d7c: Studio Voices, or any voice you own
transform-any-written-content.0d5682: Transform any written content into natural-sounding speech. Import text from images, PDFs, web pages, or type directly into the app. Mi Speaks makes all your content accessible through audio.
twenty-eight-neural-studio.78d344: Twenty-eight neural Studio Voices, plus every system voice already on your device — including Apple's Enhanced and Premium downloads and your own Personal Voice. Mi Speaks tells you which is which, so you are never handed the worst one by default.
twenty-eight-neural-voices.899e23: Twenty-eight neural voices, American and British, produced on your iPhone by an eighty-two-million-parameter model. They breathe, they phrase, and they stop sounding like a phone reading to you. Part of Premium, with a one-time download.
twenty-eight-neural-voices.eb2f6a: Twenty-eight neural voices, generated entirely on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, and they work in airplane mode.
voices-reading-along-listening.eb0337: Voices, reading along, listening anywhere and privacy, in one place. Premium features are marked as in-app purchases.
your-book-on-its.3a3c23: Your book, on its own page
